'''BAMR''' was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] news station that was secretly and swiftly formed by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] as they prepared to take over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

In [[44 ABY]], BAMR news had given up any pretense of truth in its [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi]] propaganda reporting. It accused the Jedi of smuggling spice for the purposes of, among other things, undermining [[Freedom Flight]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] observed one such biased report along [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] planetary customs immigration queue while attempting to re-enter the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
